senses.gloss: य—त्व n. the being the sound य, TPrāt., Sch.
य—तम॑ mfn. (superl.; n(˚मत्). , m. pl. ˚मे; cf. Pāṇ. v, 3, 93) who or which (of many), RV.; AV.; Br.
य-तम य-तर. See under 3. य.
य—तम॑-था (म॑-था), ind. in which of many ways, ŚBr. (यतमथा कथमथा, in the same way as always, ṢaḍvBr.)
य—तर॑ mfn. (compar.; cf. Pāṇ. v, 3, 92) who or which (of two), RV.; AV.; Br.; Up.
य—तर॑-त्र (˚र॑-त्र), ind. in which of the two places, MaitrS.
य—तर॑-था (˚र॑-था), ind. in which of two ways, ŚBr.
1. य॑त् mfn. (pr. p. of √ 5. इ) going, moving, RV. &c. &c. (अब्दे यति, in this year, L.)
यत् in comp. for यद्.
1. या॑त् mfn. (nom. यान्, याती, or यान्ती, यात्; for 2. यात् See p. 851, col. 1) going, moving &c. (in RV. i, 32, 15, ‘travelling’, as opp. to अ॑व-सित, ‘resting’).
2. या॑त् ind. (obs. abl. of 3. य, cf. ता॑त्; for 1. यात् See p. 849, col. 2) inasmuch as, so far as, as long as, since, RV.; AV. [cf. Gk. ὡς.]
यतन n. making effort or exertion, W.
यातन n. (√ 2. यत्) requital, retaliation, return (with वैरस्य, revenge, vengeance), MBh.
यातना f. See next.
यातना f. id. (˚नां-√ दा, to make requital, revenge; वैर-य्˚, vengeance; cf. above), MBh.; Hariv.; Pañcat.
acute pain, torment, agony, (esp.) punishment inflicted by Yama, the pains of hell (in BhP. personified as the daughter of भय and मृत्यु, Fear and Death), Mn.; MBh. &c.
यतनीय mfn. to be exerted or persevered or striven after (n. impers. with loc.), Sarvad.
यतव्य᳙ mf(आ)n. (fr. यतु; applied to तनू॑) = प्रयत्न-वत्, TS. (Sch. Kāṭh. यातव्य fr. यातु).
1. यातव्य mfn. to be gone or marched (n. impers.), MBh.; Hariv. (˚व्याय ind. for departure, Kām.; -ता f. the necessity for setting out on a journey, ib.)
to be marched against, to be attacked or assailed, Mālav.
2. यातव्य᳙ mf(आ)n. (fr. यातु॑) serviceable against witchcraft or against Rākṣasas, MaitrS.; Kāṭh. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 4, 121).
1. 2. यातव्य See p. 849, col. 2.
1. य॑ति m. (for 2. and 3. See col. 2 and p. 845) a disposer, RV. vii, 13, 1 (Sāy. ‘a giver’)
‘a striver’, an ascetic, devotee, one who has restrained his passions and abandoned the world, Up.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (cf. IW. 131)
N. of a mythical race of ascetics (connected with the Bhṛgus and said to have taken part in the creation of the world), RV. &c. &c.
N. of a son of Brahmā, BhP.
of a son of Nahuṣa, MBh.; Hariv.; Pur.
of a son of Viśvāmitra, MBh.
N. of Śiva, MBh.
= निकार or कार, L.
2. य॑ति (fr. 3. य correlative of त॑ति; declined only in pl. nom. acc. य॑ति), as many as (= Lat. quot), as often, how many or often, RV. (for 1. and 3. यति See col. 1 and p. 845).
3. य॑ति f. (for 1. and 2. See p. 841, cols. 1 and 2) restraint, control, guidance, TS.; Br.
stopping, ceasing, a pause (in music), Saṃgīt.
a caesura (in prosody), Piṅg.
य॑ति f(इ, ई). a widow, L.
याति See अहं-याति.
यति—कर्तव्य-गङ्गा-स्तुति f. N. of wk.
यति—चान्द्रायण n. N. of a partic. kind of penance, Mn. xi, 218.
यति—त्व n. the state of a Yati or ascetic, Cat.
यति—धर्म m. the duty of a Y˚
यति-धर्म—प्रकाश m. N. of wk.

यति—धर्मन् or यति—धर्मिन्, m. N. of a son of Śvaphalka.
यति—धर्मन् or यति—धर्मिन्, m. N. of a son of Śvaphalka.
यति—पञ्चक n. N. of 5 stanzas on the subject of ascetics (attributed to Śaṃkarācārya).
यति—पात्र n. an ascetic's bowl, a wooden vessel for collecting alms (sometimes a hollow bamboo or an earthen bowl or a gourd is used for that purpose), W.
यति—प्रतिवन्दन-खण्डन n. N. of wk.
यति—प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
यति—प्रवण-कल्प m. N. of wk.
यति—भागवत n. N. of wk.
यति—भूषणी f. N. of wk.
यति—मैथुन n. the unchaste life of ascetics, L.
यति—राज m. ‘king of ascetics’, N. of Rāmānuja (RTL. 119 &c.)
यति—राज—दण्डक m. n. N. of wk.
यति—राज—विंशति f. N. of wk.
यति—राज—विजय m. N. of wk.

यति—राज—शतक-टीका f. N. of wk.
यति—राज—सप्तति f. N. of wk.

यति—वन्दन-समर्थन n. N. of wk.

यति—विलास m. N. of a man, Cat.
यति—संस्कार m. N. of ch. of wk.
यति—संस्कार—प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
यति—संस्कार—विधि m. N. of wk.
यति—संस्कार—विधिनिर्णय m. N. of wk.
यति—समाराधन-विधि m. N. of wk.
यति—सांतपन n. N. of a partic. kind of penance (a पञ्च-गव्य lasting for three days), Prāyaśc.
यति—स्वधर्म-भिक्षा-विधि m. N. of a wk. (containing rules for the regulation of life on the part of religious mendicants, attributed to Śaṃkarācārya).
यतीन्द्र m. = यति-राज
यतीन्द्र—मत-दीपिका f. N. of wk.
यतीन्द्र—मत-दूषणी f. N. of wk.
यतीन्द्र—मत-भास्कर m. N. of wk.
यतीश m. N. of various authors (also with पण्डित), Cat.
यतीश्वर m. = यति-राज
यतीश्वर—प्रार्थना f. N. of a Stotra
यतीश्वर—स्वामिन् m. N. of an author, Cat.
यतित mfn. striven, endeavoured, attempted, tried (with inf., e.g. ˚तो हन्तुम्, attempted to be killed), MBh.
यतित n. also imp. (e.g. ˚तम् मया गन्तुम्, it was tried by me to go), ib.
यतितव्य mfn. to be endeavoured, to be striven for or after (n. impers. with loc.), R.; Pañcat.
यतिन् m. an ascetic, devotee, Pañcar.
यतिनी f. a widow, L.
यतु See यतव्य᳙.
यातु॑ m. one who goes, a traveller, L.
‘going against, attack (?)’, sorcery, witchcraft, RV.; AV.; Kāṭh.; ŚBr.
a kind of evil, spirit, fiend, demon, RV.; AV.; Kauś.
wind, L.
time, L.
यातु॑ n. = रक्षस्, L.
यातु &c. See p. 849, col. 2.
यतु॑न mfn. (prob.) moving, active, restless, RV. v, 44, 8.
यतुन See p. 841, col. 1.
1. यत्त mfn. (for 2. See under √ यम्) endeavoured, striven, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
engaged in, intent upon, prepared for, ready to (loc. dat., acc. or inf. with प्रति), MBh.; R.; Hariv.
on one's guard, watchful, cautious, ib.
attended to, guided (as a chariot), MBh.
यत See under √ यम्, p. 845.
यत॑ mfn. restrained, held in, held forth, kept down or limited, subdued, governed, controlled &c., RV. &c. &c. (cf. comp. below)
यत॑ n. restraint (?) See यतं-कर॑
the spurring or guiding of an elephant by means of the rider's feet, L.
यात॑ mfn. gone, proceeded, marched (n. also impers.), RV. &c. &c.
gone away, fled, escaped, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
passed by, elapsed, Hariv.; Var.
entered upon, pursued (as a path), R.
gone to, come or fallen into (acc. loc., or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
situated (as a heavenly body), VarBṛS.
become, turned out (क्व तद् यातम्, what has become of this?), Hariv.
known, understood, Pat.
यात॑ n. motion, progress, gait, course, drive, RV. &c. &c.
the place where a person has gone, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 68, Sch.
the past time (opp. to अन्-आगतम्, the future), VarBṛS.
the guiding or driving of an elephant with a goad, L.
यात &c. See p. 849, col. 2.
यत्न m. activity of will, volition, aspiring after, Kaṇ.; Bhāṣāp.
performance, work, Bhar.

(also pl.) effort, exertion, energy, zeal, trouble, pains, care, endeavour after (loc. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c. (यत्नं with √ कृ, आ-√ स्था, समा-√ स्था, आ-√ धा and loc. or inf., ‘to make an effort or attempt’, ‘take trouble or pains for’; यत्नेन or ˚त्नैस्, ‘with effort’, ‘carefully’, ‘eagerly’, ‘strenuously’ [also यत्न ibc.]; यत्नेनापि, ‘in spite of every effort’; यत्नैर् विना, ‘without eff˚’; यत्नात्, with or notwithstanding eff˚; महतो यत्नात् ‘, with great eff˚’, ‘very carefully’)
a special or express remark or statement, ĀpŚr., Sch.
यत्न यत्य. See p. 841, cols. 1 and 2.
यत्न—तस् ind. through or with effort, diligently, zealously, carefully, Mn.; R. &c.
यत्न—प्रतिपाद्य mfn. to explained with difficulty, not easy, MW.
यत्न—वत् mfn. possessing energy
यत्न—वत्—त्व n. making effort, taking pains about (loc.), strenuous, diligent, Mn.; MBh. &c.
यत्नाक्षेप m. an objection raised notwithstanding an eff˚ to stop it, Kāvyād.
यत्नान्तर n. another eff˚ or exertion, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 26.
यत्य् in comp. for 1. यति.
यत्य्—अनुष्ठान n. N. of wk.
यत्य्—अनुष्ठान—पद्धति f. N. of wk.
यत्य्—अन्त-कर्म-पद्धति f. N. of wk.
यत्य्—आचार-संग्रहीय-यति-संस्कार-प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
यत्य्—आचार-सप्तर्षि-पूजा f. N. of wk.
यत्य mfn. to be striven or exerted, Pat. on Pāṇ. iii, 1, 97.
यात्य m. (fr. Caus. of √ 2. यत्) ‘to be tormented’, an inhabitant of hell, L.

य॑तस् ind. (fr. 3. य, correlative of त॑तस्, and often used as abl. or instr. of the relative pron.) from which or what, whence, whereof, wherefrom, RV. &c. &c. (य॑तो यतः, ‘from whichever’, ‘from whatever’, ‘whencesoever’; यतस् ततः, ‘from any one soever’, ‘from any quarter whatever’; यत एव कुतश् च, ‘from this or that place’, ‘whencesoever’)
where, in what place, AV. &c. &c.
whither, Kāv.; Var.; Kathās. (यतो यतः, ‘whithersoever’; यतस् ततः, ‘any whither’, ‘to any place whatever’)
wherefore, for which reason, in consequence where of R.; BhP.
as, because, for, since, AV. &c. &c. (often connecting with a previous statement)
from which time forward, since when (also with प्रभृति; यतो जाता, ‘ever since birth’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
as soon as, RV. iii, 10, 6
that (= ὅτι, also to introduce an oratio recta), Kāv.; Pur.
in order that (with Pot.), BhP.
यतिथ॑ mf(ई॑)n. ‘the as manieth’, ŚBr.
यतिधा॑ ind. in as many parts or ways, AV.
यतो in comp. for यतस्.
यतो—जा॑ mfn. produced from which, VS.
यतो—द्भव (irreg. for यत-उद्भ्˚) mfn. id., Hariv.
यतो—मूल mfn. originating in or from which, R.

य॑त्र ind. (in Veda also य॑त्रा; fr. 3. य, correlative of त॑त्र, and often used for the loc. of the relative pron.) in or to which place, where, wherein, wherever, whither, RV. &c. &c. (यत्र यत्र, ‘wherever’, ‘whithersoever’; यत्र तत्र or यत्र तत्रापि, ‘anywhere whatever’ or = यस्मिंस् तस्मिन्, ‘in whatever’; यत्र तत्र दिने, ‘on any day whatever’; यत्र कुत्र, with or without चित् or अपि, ‘everywhere’ or = यस्मिन् कस्मिन्, ‘in whatever’; य॑त्र क्व॑ च or यत्र क्व चन, ‘wherever’, ‘in any place whatever’, ‘whithersoever’; यत्र क्व च, ‘anywhere whatever’; यत्र क्वापि, ‘to any place’, ‘hither and thither’; यत्र वा, ‘or elsewhere’)
on which occasion, in which case, if, when, as, RV. &c. &c. (यत्र तत्र, ‘on every occasion’, यत्र क्व च, ‘whenever’)
in order that, RV. iii, 32, 14; ix, 29, 5
that (with Pot. after ‘to doubt, wonder &c.’), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 148
(with Pres.), Hit. i, 176 (v.l.)

यात्रा f. going, setting off, journey, march, expedition, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (with प्राणान्तिकी or और्ध्वदेहिकी = death; यात्रां-√ या or दा, to undertake an expedition, take the field; यात्राम्-√ पृछ्, to wish luck, Divyāv.)
going on a pilgrimage (cf. गङ्गा- and तीर्थ-य्˚)
a festive train, procession, Kathās.; Rājat.; Hit. (cf. देव-य्˚)
a feast, festival (= उत्सव), Bālar.
support of life, livelihood, maintenance, Mn.; MBh. &c.
intercourse (with लौकिकी, worldly intercourse = जगद्-य्˚), Mn. xi, 184
way, means, expedient, L.
passing away time, W.
practice, usage, custom, W.
N. of a partic. kind of astronomical wk. (cf. योग-य्˚)
of a sort of dramatic entertainment (popular in Bengal), W.
यात्रा यात्रिक &c. See p. 849, col. 3.
यत्र—का॑मम् ind. wherever one pleases accord. to pleasure or wish, ŚBr.
यत्र—कामावसाय m. the supernatural power of transporting one's self anywhere one likes (said to belong to Yogins), Cat.
यत्र—कामाव˚सायिन् mfn. (in ˚सायि-ता f. and ˚सायि-त्व n.) possessing that power, Pur.
यत्र—कामाव˚सायि-ता f.
यत्र—कामाव˚सायि-त्व n.
यत्र—तत्र-शय mfn. lying down or sleeping anywhere, MBh.
यत्र—सायं-गृह and यत्र—सायम्-प्रतिश्रय, mfn. taking up an abode wherever evening overtakes one, ib.
यत्र—सायं-गृह and यत्र—सायम्-प्रतिश्रय, mfn. taking up an abode wherever evening overtakes one, ib.

यत्राकूत॑ n. the aim or object in view, TS.
यत्रास्तमित-शायिन् mfn. lying down to sleep wherever sunset finds one, MBh.
यत्रेच्छक mfn. wherever one likes, ib.
यत्रोद्भूत mfn. wherever arisen, Kāvyād.
यत्रत्य mfn. where being or dwelling, relating to which place, Mālatīm.; BhP.
यतीयस (?) n. silver, L.
यतुका or यतूका f. a species of plant, L.
यतुका or यतूका f. a species of plant, L.
यत्-कर यत्-काम, यत्-कारणम् &c. See col. 3.
यत्—कर mf(आ)n. doing or undertaking which, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 21, Vārtt.
य॑त्—काम (य॑त्-), mfn. desiring or wishing which, RV.
यत्—का˚म्या॑ (˚म्या॑), ind. with which view or design, ŚBr.
यत्—कारणम् ind. for which cause or reason, wherefore, why, MārkP.
as, because, since (also ˚णात्), Pañcat.
यत्—कारि॑न् mfn. doing or undertaking which, TBr.
यत्—कार्यम् ind. with which intention, MārkP.
यत्—किं-चन See col. 2. under य॑द्
यत्—किं-चन—कारक mfn. doing anything whatever, acting at random, MBh.
यत्—किं-चन—कारिन् mfn. acting at random or precipitately (˚रि-ता f.), Kād.; Divyāv.
यत्—किं-चन—कारि-ता f.

यत्—किं-चन—वाद m. a r˚ assertion, Nyāyas., Sch.

यत्—किं-˚चिच्-चारक m. a servant of all work, L.

यत्—कुल mfn. of which family, Hariv.
यत्—कृते ind. for which reason, wherefore, why, MBh.; Kathās.
यत्—क्रतु mfn. having which resolution, forming which plan, BṛĀrUp.
यत्—पराक्रम mfn. of which valour, being so courageous, MBh.
यत्—पृष्ठ mfn. connected with which Pṛṣṭha (kind of Stotra), ŚāṅkhŚr.

यत॑—स्रुच् (यत॑-), mfn. raising or stretching out the sacrificial ladle, RV.
यताक्षासु-मनो-बुद्धि mfn. one who controls his eyes and breath and soul and mind, BhP.

यति—नृत्य n. a kind of dance, Saṃgīt.

यात्-सत्त्र See p. 849, col. 2.
यात-याम ˚मन्. See p. 849, col. 2.
यात—या˚म-त्व n. uselessness, old age, Gobh.
यातानुयात n. (prob.) the going and following g. शाक-पार्थिवादि.
यातायात n. going and coming, BhP.
ebb and flow, Sadukt.
यातोपयात n. going and coming
यातोपया˚तिक mfn. g. अक्ष-द्यूतादि.
